TVS Family Asset Split Remains Unresolved, Say Mallika Srinivasan and Lakshmi Venu

Mallika Srinivasan and Lakshmi Venu have stated that an economic settlement regarding the division of assets within the Venu Srinivasan (VS) family has not been reached. Srinivasan clarified that a memorandum of understanding signed in March 2024 pertains only to brand rights and associated obligations, not to the ownership of family assets or a final economic settlement. Both Venu and Srinivasan have disputed claims that an asset division has been completed.
